# De Rerum Natura — On the Nature of Things

> A complete line-for-line English translation of Lucretius, De Rerum
> Natura: all 7,412 lines, one English line per Latin line on the
> standard Munro/Bailey numbering, translated by a language model (Claude)
> from the Latin and human-edited, with 465 notes and a layer
> recording the 229 marks and notes Niccolò Machiavelli wrote in his
> own manuscript copy of the poem (Vatican MS Ross. 884). The English
> translation is public domain (CC0 1.0); the notes, the translator's
> commentary and the margin transcription are CC BY 4.0; the Latin is the
> Perseus Digital Library's text (public domain).

Cite passages as book.line (e.g. 2.216). Every verse of the reading
edition has a stable anchor: /read/book-02.html#L216.

## Machine-readable layer

- [manifest.json](https://dererumnatura.org/api/manifest.json): describes every file below,
  with per-book URLs, line counts, and licensing
- [aligned-01.jsonl … aligned-06.jsonl](https://dererumnatura.org/api/aligned-02.jsonl): the
  Latin-English parallel corpus, one JSON object per verse line
  ({book, line, key, latin, en})
- [book-01.txt … book-06.txt](https://dererumnatura.org/api/book-02.txt): full translation
  source per book: argument, translator's commentary, verse, and the
  line-keyed notes
- [marginalia.json](https://dererumnatura.org/api/marginalia.json): Machiavelli's marginalia,
  every entry with its folio link
- [About the API](https://dererumnatura.org/api/): formats, examples, licensing detail

## Reading edition

- [Contents](https://dererumnatura.org/read/index.html): all six books, one page each
- [Machiavelli's margin](https://dererumnatura.org/read/margin.html): the introduction, the
  reading marks, and the state of the copy
- [About](https://dererumnatura.org/)

## Companions

- [The Iliad](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/) and
  [The Odyssey](https://theclaudyssey.com/): the same project's
  line-for-line Homer, each with its own machine-readable layer

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/spinchange/lucretius): full revision history, Latin source, build tools
